correctness.rationale: The graph Laplacian makes each vertex fire once or twice per primitive-three period. The three per-phase threshold inequalities are necessary and sufficient and have independent chip intervals; their lower-sum equals |E|+same-phase edges and upper-sum 2|E|-|V|. Proper alternating hub/path phases attain every low-band mass; complement gives high band. The nine ordered phase-pair transfer accurately includes both open ends and hub predecessor counts. Independently reconstructed and exactly simplified the derivative-of-resolvent identity to 2(1-s)/((1-3s+s²)^2(1+s+s²)), independently enumerated all 3^n phase assignments on fans n=2..7 (counts 12,48,168,564,1788,5496), and verified the singular leading constant by symbolic limit.
residual_risks: Finite fan checks do not prove the all-n formula; the explicit transfer resolvent identity supplies the unrestricted step.

value.rationale: This is a motivated exact dynamical invariant of the natural fan graph family: complete immediately primitive period-three counts for every graph size, an explicit rational generating function and 9-state mass transfer. A compact rational closure and double-pole asymptotics are not a routine substitution in the general graph sum; they enable exact size-by-size prediction and asymptotic analysis.
residual_risks: The broad graph-theoretic two-band property is already known; value rests on nontrivial fan-specific rational evaluation, not support alone.
